en.title: J
en.summary: The letter J is the eleventh letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Sound of the letter
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /ʒ/. It makes the sound /ʒ/, heard in (joc) /ʒos/, which means down or below. This letter has only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Round your lips slightly and push them forward. Raise the front of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. Blow air smoothly through the narrow gap. Vibrate your vocal cords at the same time. Place your fingers on your throat to feel the steady buzz.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: This letter always keeps its single sound. You pronounce it as the sound /ʒ/ in all native positions, like in the word (plajă) /ˈpla.ʒə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: English speakers often replace this sound with the sound at the start of jam. Do not stop the air or add a hard front sound. Keep the air flowing smoothly without any sudden block, just like the middle consonant in the English word measure.
